articles.summary: New Analyses Across Obstructive and Non-obstructive HCM Expand Clinical Evidence for Aficamten SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Cytokinetics, Incorporated (Nasdaq: CYTK) today announced that new data related to aficamten were presented at the Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Medical Society (HCMS) Scientific Sessions held in collaboration with the American Heart Association Scientific Sessions 2026 in Chicago, IL including two late-breaking oral abstracts with additional data from ACACIA-HCM, and one poster presentation with new data from FOREST-HCM. “The new data further enrich the growing body of clinical evidence establishing aficamten as a potentially paradigm-shifting therapy across the spectrum of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy,” said Stephen Heitner, M.D., Cytokinetics’ Chief Medical Officer. “The advanced imaging data provide crucial insights into favorable cardiac remodeling, showing that aficamten may reduce key structural markers of the disease.
